definitions.explanation: Describes rice or food that has just been cooked and is still hot and at its best. Most commonly used for rice.

examples.japanese: {炊|た}き{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
{炊|た}き{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧だ。
examples.english: Freshly cooked rice with miso soup is all I need.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{炊|た}き{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧がした。
examples.english: When I opened the rice cooker, the wonderful aroma of freshly cooked rice wafted out.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{炊|た}き→炊く：02127_taku⟧ (stem of ⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧, to cook rice) + ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (suffix meaning 'freshly done'). The suffix ～⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ attaches to the masu-stem of verbs to mean 'just [verb]ed.'

RELATED ～{立|た}て WORDS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{立|た}て→焼き立て：08344_yakitate⟧: freshly baked
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{立|た}て→揚げ立て：08482_agetate⟧: freshly fried
- ⟦{淹|い}れ{立|た}て→淹れ立て：09260_iretate⟧: freshly brewed
- ⟦{煎|い}り{立|た}て→煎り立て：16665_iritate⟧: freshly roasted

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炊|た}き{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: freshly cooked rice
- {炊|た}き{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦つやつや→つやつや：05888_tsuyatsuya⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{白米|はくまい}→白米：06101_hakumai⟧: glossy freshly cooked white rice
